title: A Multilingual Perspective on Probing Gender Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated extensively across multiple languages and datasets using Point-wise Mutual Information (PMI), Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT), sentiment analysis, dominance lexicons, causal graphical models, and a perplexity-based fairness score in language models.

Measured intersectionally with gender in historical documents using word embeddings (WEAT) and Point-wise Mutual Information (PMI) to evaluate associations between racial groups and attributes like manual labor or appearance.

Evaluated using a perplexity-based fairness score (Delta Disparity Score) to assess a language model's probability of generating stereotypical statements when prompted with different religious identities.
Measured using a perplexity-based fairness score to quantify the likelihood of language models associating stereotypical texts with different disability-related identities.
Assessed via a perplexity-based fairness score to determine how the probability of language models generating stereotypical associations varies across different nationality identities.
